MESSAGE FROM DANA:
I'm planning a long day of screen work. How should I set it up?

response.text: To set yourself up for success, start by positioning your monitor at eye level and about an arm's length away to reduce strain. Remember to follow the 20-20-20 rule—every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds. Finally, make sure your chair provides good lumbar support and keep a large bottle of water nearby to stay hydrated.
